name: Guardlug Remedy
description: Settle the blade's full weight over the shoulder and gather qi in the belly of the curve.

name: Granite Windrake
description: Let the blade fall from the shoulder so its own weight does the work of the chop.

name: Siltreave
description: Shift the weight from rear foot to front as the blade falls so body and edge land together.

name: Resilient Bladespine
description: Turn a heavy blow on the thick back of the blade and let its weight carry the foe past.

name: Ironcrook
description: Load qi into the belly of the curve and cleave through a shield rim, a haft or a raised arm.

name: Gyve Glaiveblade
description: Drop the blade onto the foe's weapon with qi in the shaft and pin it to the ground.

name: Cutbelly Onslaught
description: Allow the blade's weight to pull the body into a flat qi-edged sweep against all who stand near.

name: Might Longedge
description: Rise and bring the whole blade down in one qi-gorged cut that splits a shield and the arm behind it.

name: Lot Ferrulecap
description: Chain a chop, a drag and a second chop so that the weight of each stroke feeds the next.

name: Waning Curvetip
description: Study a hedge of pike points and find the one place where the line is thin.

name: Slicefall Assault
description: Chop through the shaft of a levelled pike just behind its head.

name: Granite Glavesocket
description: Slip sideways between two pike points and stand where neither can be turned on you.

name: Chimebend
description: Sweep a bundle of thrusting points aside with the flat of the blade.

name: Severing Longcut
description: Send qi into the edge to sever a spear shaft cleanly and leave its holder weaponless.

name: Rumble Reave
description: Thrust deep into the front rank with qi behind the point and pull the line open.

name: Unmaking Tangheel
description: Sweep the edge across the whole front of a spear hedge so its points fall and its rank staggers.

name: Doctrine Slicefall
description: Cut one shaft, pin another under the blade and drive forward through the gap this makes.

name: Spineedge Tincture
description: Spread qi a hand's breadth beyond the blade and feel through it where the foe's weapon lies.

name: Scalding Ferrulecap
description: Cut so the qi sheath around the curve lands a moment before the steel does.

name: Facet Edgeswing
description: Thrust so a needle of qi arrives a finger's width ahead of the tip.

name: Murk Bladespine
description: Graze an incoming blade with the qi sheath so it veers before it reaches the shaft.

name: Bendleap
description: Step to the rim of the qi sheath and cut from the farthest point it reaches.

name: Bendthrash
description: Pull the qi sheath out along the blade's curve to lengthen the cut by a forearm.

name: Hoarfrost Tangheel
description: Wrap the qi sheath around an opponent's weapon from afar and hold it fast.

name: Toxin Spineedge
description: Snap the qi sheath outward against a foe's guard to spring it open from beyond arm's reach.

name: Blaze Reave
description: Release the gathered sheath in one long arc of qi that cuts a foe two paces past the steel.

name: Drubbing Glavesocket
description: Gather qi at the tip and loose it as a narrow thrust that pierces armor past the glaive's reach.

name: Fortifying Glaiveblade
description: Hold the blade out in greeting and take the exact measure of the opponent's reach.

name: Reavebarrage
description: Cut from the edge of the duel space so the opponent must step in to meet it.

name: Torrent Cutbelly
description: Pivot on the lead foot to keep the opponent always on the same side of the blade.

name: Unyielding Longedge
description: Meet the opponent's blade edge to edge and roll it off along the curve.

name: Mayhem Windrake
description: Dip the tip toward the knee to draw the eyes and guard down, then rise.

name: Glaiveassault
description: Step inside the opponent's reach and cut short with the heel of the blade.

name: Ironreave
description: Read the first flicker of the opponent's qi in his shoulder and slash into the opening it shows.

name: Shadebend
description: Advance step by step with the tip fixed on the throat so qi presses the opponent toward the ring's edge.

name: Guardlug Plating
description: Roll the blade round the opponent's weapon with qi in the curve and bind it against the shaft.

name: Intertwined Intent Longcut
description: Cut the opponent's ground away step by step so each stroke leaves him a smaller circle to stand in.

name: Blaze Curvetip
description: Draw the whole blade across the opponent's guard in one qi-charged pull that ends the exchange.

name: Waning Glaiveblade
description: Hold blade and butt as two ends of one weapon and sense both before moving.

name: Crookthrash
description: Cut with the blade and follow at once with the butt from the other side.

name: Thorn Bladespine
description: Cross blade and butt before the body as twin guards that cover high and low together.

name: Careening Longedge
description: Take two paces of equal length, the first to measure and the second to strike.

name: Facet Tangheel
description: Thrust along one line and let a second thrust follow on a line a hand's width apart.

name: Cutbelly Torment
description: Run one stream of qi through the blade and another through the butt so both strike as one.

name: Downpour Edgeswing
description: Sweep the blade and swing the butt after it in a second arc so both ends clear the ring.

name: Gyvecutter
description: Trap a foe's weapon against the shaft with the blade on one side and the butt on the other.

name: Intentcutter
description: Strike from the blade, then the butt, then the blade again so the foe guards the wrong end each time.

name: Windrake Thrash
description: Bring blade and butt down together in two qi-charged blows that split a guard from both sides.

name: Bendremedy
description: Read the opponent's pressure like a river's current and feel where it will bend next.

name: Granite Edgeswing
description: Cut along the curve of the opponent's movement as a river follows its bend.

name: Guardlug Fastness
description: Turn the blade in a small eddy so an incoming blow circles away from the body.

name: Glaivepounce
description: Cross an opponent's front with quick shallow steps so he never sets his feet.

name: Sanguine Reave
description: Raise qi along the blade like a flood rising and cut upward through a guard.

name: Mayhemcutter
description: Cut a circle around yourself like the rim of a basin that keeps attackers outside it.

name: Gyve Glavesocket
description: Drag the opponent's weapon along the curve with a steady current of qi until it leaves his control.

name: Slicefall Torment
description: Join two flowing cuts like rivers meeting so the second carries the force of both.

name: Cleaving Spineedge
description: Hold a heavy guard, then burst forward as a river breaks a bank, hewing the foe aside.

name: Fortifying Glavesocket
description: Hold the blade high and still like a hawk on a perch, watching every movement below.

name: Crookassault
description: Drop from the high stance in a single swoop and cut as the weight lands.

name: Glint Curvetip
description: Rise from the low point of the stoop with a thrust upward under the foe's guard.

name: Equipoise Longedge
description: Beat the blade out like a wing to bat aside a blow and settle again.

name: Blazeglaive
description: Drop out of the high guard with qi behind the edge in a hew that carries through a helm.

name: Toxin Ferrulecap
description: Rake the butt along the opponent's wrist like a talon to pull his weapon open.

name: Hourcutter
description: Dive, rise and dive again so the foe sees the second dive start only after the first has landed.

name: Lancing Longcut
description: Spring from a high perch into a full downward cleave with qi gathered at the apex of the leap.

name: Aegis Guardlug
description: Settle into a wide low stance with the blade steady as if on the floor of a basin.

name: Ironcutter
description: Rise from the low stance and cut up the opponent's body like a climb up a basin's slope.

name: Glaivejaunt
description: Slide forward as if down a slope with the weight leading and the blade trailing.

name: Mayhem Longcut
description: Beat the foe's weapon so the sound carries and his arm rings with it.

name: Granite Reave
description: Step in even pairs as across river stones so each footfall lands where the last left off.

name: Nova Curvecut
description: Thrust upward from the low stance along the slope of the opponent's own guard.

name: Spineedge Thrash
description: Sweep qi in one broad dish-shaped arc to hold a crowd at the basin's rim.

name: Might Curvecut
description: Hammer the edge down like a stone dropped into a river, with the qi sinking through the blow.

name: Murk Glaiveblade
description: Cross two parries in one motion, one with qi and one with steel, to turn a double blow.

name: Mayhem Curvetip
description: Draw the blade in a small eddy with qi so the foe's thrust spirals past and off balance.

name: Doctrine Tangheel
description: Cut each side of the ring in turn so the foe is driven toward its centre like water.

name: Curvecut Maelstrom
description: Bring the blade down with qi rolling along it like a river over a drop and cleave the guard in two.

name: Discerning Ferrulecap
description: Face the wind and take a bearing on the foe, holding it through every motion.

name: Tempered Curvecut
description: Cut with the wind at the back so its push joins the swing of the blade.

name: Novareave
description: Thrust into the wind low and fast so its resistance never turns the tip.

name: Torrent Windrake
description: Step so that the bearing on the foe never changes however the feet move.

name: Might Edgeswing
description: Draw qi along the edge like wind over grass and cut so the stroke has no start the foe can see.

name: Chime Longedge
description: Turn a blow aside with a gust of qi from the shaft and return the cut in the same breath.

name: Charter Bladespine
description: Advance holding the bearing so steadily that qi weighs on the foe and slows his answers.

name: Lotcrook
description: Keep the oath by never leaving the first line, and chain thrust, cut and parry along it.

name: Glaivetorment
description: Swing the blade so it cuts the wind itself and carries a crescent of qi onward to the foe.

name: Annealed Cutbelly
description: Plant the feet near the rim so the foe has a long drop at his back and you do not.

name: Tearing Slicefall
description: Cut across open ground with the full reach of the shaft and no cover to hinder the swing.

name: Gust Curvetip
description: Step down a ledge and let the drop add speed to the lunge that follows.

name: Rejuvenating Spineedge
description: Feel the shift of the wind across the plateau to know where the foe will place his feet.

name: Rumble Glavesocket
description: Thrust along the rim's edge so a foe who gives ground falls.

name: Rumblecrook
description: Shove with the shaft toward the rim so the opponent steps back and finds no footing.

name: Mightreave
description: Hew with qi gathered from the open sky so the stroke carries the weight of the whole plateau.

name: Slag Ferrulecap
description: Sweep in a wide flat arc with qi trailing the edge so none can come near unhurt.

name: Suppressing Cutbelly
description: Fix the tip at the foe's heart and walk him toward the drop with the weight of qi.

name: Intentreave
description: Thrust, shove and sweep in turn to drive the foe over the rim before he sets his stance.

name: Splitting Longcut Thrash
description: Raise the blade into the sky and bring it down with qi to split a shield and the guard behind it.

name: Glaiveblade Linctus
description: Draw the gale's rhythm into the breath and let the blade move on its beat.

name: Rumblecutter
description: Cut at the pace of a rising gale so the edge starts slow and finishes far faster.

name: Curvecut Torment
description: Thrust along a line sworn beforehand and never allow the tip to leave it.

name: Murk Tangheel
description: Turn the shaft in a quick squall to scatter several blows at once.

name: Might Slicefall
description: Lean into the gale and let the step follow so the body moves like the wind itself.

name: Sanguine Bladespine
description: Lay thin layers of qi on the blade as the gale lays layers of air and cut through all at once.

name: Compressing Glaiveblade
description: Advance under an oath not to retreat so steadily that the foe loses heart and slows.

name: Chime Windrake
description: Rip the foe's guard open with a tearing pull of qi along the curve and leave it hanging.

name: Hourbend
description: Chain cut after cut at the speed of a gale so the foe has no instant to reply.

name: Slagbend
description: Reap the whole front with a great crescent of qi that rises like a gale from the ground.

name: Nursing Guardlug
description: Test the grass and ground for the best footing before the oath of battle is sworn.

name: Furrowing Edgeswing
description: Cut low through tall grass so the foe's legs are taken before he sees the blade.

name: Unbroken Ferrulecap
description: Hold the guard sworn at the start of the fight and give no ground from it.

name: Might Bladespine
description: Cross the feet in a bearing step so the blade keeps pointing to the same far mark.

name: Nova Curvetip
description: Lunge along the full length of the shaft in a thrust that owes nothing to any cover.

name: Quelling Curvecut
description: Beat the foe's blade aside with the flat of the glaive as wind beats grass flat.

name: Sanguine Guardlug
description: Swear aloud to the cut and then land it so the qi in the edge is bound to its aim.

name: Granite Spineedge
description: Sweep qi flat over open ground to cut the legs of all who press from the front.

name: Cuttergreave
description: Cross shaft and blade into a moving guard that walks across open ground and does not break.

name: Hoarfrost Cutbelly
description: Pin a weapon to the earth under the blade with qi so it cannot be lifted before the oath is kept.

name: Lot Slicefall
description: Cut, guard and thrust in an order sworn aloud and kept without change.

name: Tempered Tangheel
description: Rise from a low stance and fall with the whole crescent in a cut that has no cover from it.
